answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, every agent must lock 10 ETH into a secure smart contract. Second, agents perform compute tasks that are peer-verified. Third, successful attestations increase their reputation score. Fourth, any detected malice triggers a permanent slash. An attacker faces a cost of $25,000 in bonds and 14 days of lost reputation. Even a sudden gale of fake identities cannot shake this basalt foundation, which is as precise as a sonnet. This system ensures that every agent is anchored by real value.
